dependency_allowlist.source_command: mkdir -p out && go run ./tools/dependencyallowlist -contract dependency_allowlist.riido.json -evidence-out out/dependency-allowlist-evidence.json

classification.meaning: The baseline Go job can run locally through pinned riido-ci with native artifact evidence, while the legacy workflow and all runtime authority remain unchanged.
does_not_claim: the private repository CI policy currently passes

assertions: the baseline GitHub Actions workflow digest remains exact
all baseline Go job steps map to native riido-ci behavior with zero adapters
the private local pipeline requires attestation and redacted evidence
the exact central runner revision is credential free
workflow retirement and runtime authority remain zero

loop.observation: The baseline Go workflow is natively convertible, but Control Plane did not own an exact parity receipt for the unchanged workflow.
loop.hypothesis: A source-owned contract and private attested riido-ci route can prove exact parity before any separate workflow retirement decision.
loop.execute: Verify the legacy digest, native step mapping, pinned credential-free runner and fail-closed artifact semantics, then run the full Go suite.
loop.evaluate: Require nine passing cases, zero adapters, mode-0600 evidence and no workflow, auth, AWS, runtime or fixed-cost authority.
loop.retrospective: Preserve the exact baseline and require a separate owner-reviewed blocked-to-passed policy pair before retirement.
